This preserves storage at the cost of FFF search performance there. General FFF process isolation and hard-link/bind-mount aliases or additional custom Database.layerFromPath databases remain unverified.

verified.test: the non-native picker path validates the selection before forwarding it
verified.unlock: CLOSED at the funnel, with an honest boundary. `useDirectoryPicker` now validates every picked directory through `validateDirectorySelection` before `input.onSelect`, on BOTH branches (native and server dialog), so no unreadable path reaches `projects.open()` from any add-project call site — all of them go through this one funnel. Evidence: `directory-picker.test.ts` 5 passed (2 new funnel contracts, 2 existing native-path contracts, 1 kind contract); app typecheck exit 0; lint-changed 190 files exit 0; prettier clean; `git diff --check` clean. `throwOnError: true` is set on both clients in server-sdk.tsx (:268 server-level, :326 dir-level), so a 404 from `file.list` rejects rather than resolving — the validation is not a false green. BROWSER NEGATIVE IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE BY DESIGN, measured not assumed: the V2 dialog disables its confirm button while the root is unlistable (dialog-select-directory-v2.tsx:142,153,357), and the legacy web picker swallows `file.list` failure into an empty list (directory-picker-domain.ts:384), so an unreadable directory never becomes a selectable row. The funnel validation is therefore defense-in-depth at the trust boundary (including the desktop native OS dialog, which can return any path), not a fix for a UI-reachable path. No browser spec was invented to make this look stronger than it is.
